whyItMatters: The cookie declares SameSite=None and does not declare Partitioned.
actions: Add Partitioned beside SameSite=None wherever the cookie must work in an embedded context.
Use SameSite=Lax or Strict instead where the cookie is never sent from an embed.
verification: Re-read Set-Cookie and confirm every SameSite=None cookie is either Partitioned or no longer None.
